rca_of_issue: ROOT CAUSE: In parse_pdf pdfplumber table branch (server.py ~L595-650), each row produced `f"{first_cell} {address} {code_match}"` — dropping the Notes column contents. Circuit-format PDFs place the customer name + phone + CEP in the Notes column, so downstream _extract_customer_and_at (needs the customer name string) and _resolve_cep_to_latlon (needs the 8-digit CEP) never saw that data and stops arrived at the frontend with cliente=null and lat/lon=null → user saw 'wrong points on the map'. FIX: append `notes_extra` (Notes minus the tracking code) to line_parts, so the merged text carries name + CEP through the same downstream extractors that already work for the text/manual path. VERIFICATION: /api/parse-text with the merged text produces cliente + lat/lon for both rows (test_parse_text_with_customer_and_cep_resolves_latlon).
